name: Godrej Consumer Products Ltd
title: Godrej Consumer Products Ltd - 532424 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 standalone India volume +8% and EBITDA +18% at 24.7% margin, but management flags near-term margin pressure from crude-linked inflation (7–9% RM) and a revenue-presentation change that optically lifts margins.

triggers.label: Price hikes 4–7% across categories
triggers.quote: In soaps, we have taken our prices by 5%. In detergents, we have taken up prices again by 6% or 7%

triggers.label: Margins to dip for 3–4 months
triggers.quote: So, it may take 3 to 4 months again, of a little bit of a dip in percentage margins.

triggers.label: India volume growth 8%
triggers.quote: We are also quite happy with 8% volume growth in India.

triggers.label: Indonesia pricing pressure bottomed
triggers.quote: the pricing pressures we have been calling out over the last several quarters have now largely bottomed out

triggers.label: Soaps volumes muted, no clear recovery
triggers.quote: it doesn't seem to be, from what I see a game changer 1 way or the other for FY27.

guidance.value: lower than normative in Q1 and probably Q2
guidance.quote: I still expect, as I told you, lower than normative margins on Q1 and probably Q2
we continue to expect operating conditions to improve from FY 2027 as the market normalizes
So, I think what we will get in Indonesia is kind of mid -single-digit volume, high single -digit value going forward.
So, the tax ETR is likely to remain the same as this year.

red_flags.label: Revenue restatement lifts reported margins
red_flags.quote: Margin percentages would be optically higher under the new presentation simply because the denominator is smaller

red_flags.label: Soaps volume weakness and EBITDA pressure
red_flags.quote: So overall, I am expecting lower margins still this oil remains at 100, 110

evasions.quote: As far as t he formulation and competitor it not proper for me to comment on that

evasions.topic: Q1 EBITDA recovery and FY27 guidance deferred
evasions.quote: Percy, we'll give you guidance on Monday.
